My name is Harsh Patial, and I am a final-year B.Tech student at VIT Bhopal, specializing in Computer Science with a focus on Machine Learning. I currently have a CGPA of 8.9 30-40% TIME PROJECTS Over the past two years, I have worked on projects related to Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Natural Language Processing. That is why I am excited about this opportunity. Thank you.
